definitions: breach = first tick with HF < 1 on the dataset path, stamped at the previous tick (strict). Lead = breach − start of the earliest warn+ (critical) episode still open. censored = that episode opened at the first read. False alarm = worsening message with no breach in 72h.

E1census.source: oct10-2025/evidence.json included census accounts, priced on recall-coverage data/chain/e1/chainlink_rounds (mainnet feeds) and Binance 1m for OP / ARB, each scaled to the account state price at its liquidation minute; breach = first minute with HF < 1 on the path (at the latest the liquidation minute)

E1.source: recall-coverage EV-1 Morpho rows (inputs/oct10 morpho_liquidations.csv + data/chain/e1); oracle price() per block

unreplayable.reason: no oracle path in the pull (chain 8453)

E3.source: recall-coverage EV-3 positions_start + reserve_state + underlying_prices; HF per tick by the dataset formula (e3.ts:398-407)

E2.source: own pull (not a pinned table): Morpho API hourly position history on every xUSD / deUSD / sdeUSD market, DefiLlama CoinGecko prices
uncovered: Euler, Silo, Gearbox, Fluid and other venues; chains the Morpho API does not serve (Plasma 9745, Avalanche 43114, Sonic 146 per spec §5). Positions closed before the window are excluded by construction.

E4.source: recall-coverage EV-4 positions_t0 + oracle (price() per block t0-300..t0+600, every 5th to t0+2h, hourly to t0+24h) + market borrow rate accrual
